_comment: Machine-readable record of the owner's real product fixture authorization. This file is the ENFORCEMENT POINT for the authorization's own scope clause -- 'Authorization applies only to the exact files listed in this document'. tools/validate-authorized-assets.js refuses any asset not named here, so the scope limit is a mechanical check rather than a promise. Adding a filename here without a corresponding owner authorization is exactly the failure this file exists to prevent.

authorization.scopeClause: Authorization applies only to the exact files listed in this document.
notPermitted: adding unrelated retailer/catalog images not listed above

assets.note: Expected to carry text/logo/directional pattern -- the mirroring, cropping, orientation and stretch canary. Shot class to be confirmed on delivery.

_note_on_directory: Authorized product imagery is delivered into fixtures/real-products/ (canonical path as of 2026-09-04 -- an earlier fixtures/products/ path was renamed and must not be reintroduced) and is TRACKED deliberately (like fixtures/garments/), not ignored. It is isolated-development-only and must never be bundled into a production build -- see docs/fixture-consent-log.md.
_note_on_format: PHASE 1 FORMAT DECISION (2026-09-04): authorized fixtures will be supplied as PNG. The pure-Node codec in packages/static-renderer already decodes PNG; no JPEG decoder, no TIFF support, and no image-decoding dependency will be added for this corpus -- tests/privacy/dependencyBoundary.test.js's empty external-runtime-dependency allow-list stays as-is. The seven filenames above are exactly what the owner authorized and are NOT renamed here: 'tee-flatlay-001.jpg' does not authorize 'tee-flatlay-001.png'. Until the owner supplies the exact PNG filenames (as a change to this array, not an inference from these), Gate B stays HOLD -- OWNER FIXTURE CORPUS REQUIRED. See docs/fixture-consent-log.md.
